parameters.query: SELECT i.id,i.customer_id AS destination,COALESCE(MAX(a.attempt_number),0)+1 AS attempt_number FROM review_invites i JOIN feedback_records f ON f.id=i.feedback_id LEFT JOIN delivery_attempts a ON a.entity_id=i.id AND a.kind='review_invite' WHERE i.status='pending' AND i.scheduled_at<=now() AND f.opted_out=false AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_events e WHERE e.feedback_id=f.id AND e.event_type='review_verified') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_invites prior WHERE prior.customer_id=i.customer_id AND prior.id<>i.id AND prior.status='sent' AND prior.created_at>now()-interval '30 days') GROUP BY i.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 25;

INSERT INTO delivery_attempts(entity_type,entity_id,kind,attempt_number,status,provider,error_code,next_retry_at) VALUES('review_invite',$1,'review_invite',$2,$3,'local-mock',$4,CASE WHEN $3='retry' THEN now()+make_interval(secs=>$5) END) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; UPDATE review_invites SET status=CASE WHEN $3='delivered' THEN 'sent' WHEN $3='dlq' THEN 'delivery_failed' ELSE 'pending' END WHERE id=$1; INSERT INTO dead_letter_events(entity_type,entity_id,reason,payload) SELECT 'review_invite',$1,'delivery_exhausted',jsonb_build_object('status',$4) WHERE $3='dlq';
